name: Oak Ridge Estates
tagline: Comfortable, tree-lined manufactured home living in Washington's capital region.
officeHours: Mon–Fri: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM | Sat: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM | Sun: Closed
description: Oak Ridge Estates is our flagship family-owned community featuring towering shade trees, newly resurfaced two-lane streets, designated two-vehicle off-street parking, a community center, and lighted walkways. Offering a quiet, neighborly atmosphere just minutes from downtown Olympia and Puget Sound.

pricing.utilitiesIncluded: Curbside weekly trash & recycling service, seasonal common-area landscaping
pricing.utilitiesSeparate: City water/sewer (sub-metered to each home), electricity, high-speed fiber internet
pricing.leaseTerms: 12-month standard lease term; month-to-month option after year one

amenities: Lighted Paved Streets with Speed Bumps

rulesSnapshot.pets: Up to 2 domestic pets per household (dogs under 40 lbs; non-aggressive breeds; indoor cats welcome). Leash required in common spaces.
rulesSnapshot.parking: 2 passenger vehicles per home on concrete driveways. No overnight street parking or parking on lawns.
rulesSnapshot.quietHours: 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM daily for peace of all residents.
rulesSnapshot.maintenance: Residents maintain personal grass cutting within their lot perimeter; community crew handles common grounds.
rulesSnapshot.rvs: Designated secure RV / camper storage area available for resident lease at $45/mo.

nearbyServices.schools: North Thurston High School (1.8 mi), Nisqually Middle (2.2 mi), Meadows Elementary (1.1 mi)
nearbyServices.healthcare: Providence St. Peter Hospital (3.5 miles), MultiCare Indigo Urgent Care (1.2 miles)
nearbyServices.commute: I-5 corridor access (4 mins), Downtown Olympia (12 mins), JBLM Main Gate (18 mins)
nearbyServices.recreation: Tolmie State Park on Puget Sound (4 miles), Regional Athletic Complex (2.5 miles)

faqs.q: Can I move my own manufactured home to Oak Ridge Estates?
faqs.a: Yes! We welcome HUD-code compliant homes (2010 or newer) with quality siding and pitched shingle roofs. Our site manager conducts a quick exterior photo review and site coordination at no cost.

faqs.q: What utilities are included in the lot rent?
faqs.a: Curbside trash and recycling pickup are included with lot rent. City water, sewer, and electric are individually metered, so you only pay for your household's actual usage.

faqs.q: What are the tenant qualification criteria?
faqs.a: We require a completed application, verifiable household income of at least 2.5 times the monthly rent/fee, standard background screening, and positive rental/housing references. Decisions are typically made within 24 to 48 business hours.

name: Pine Valley Living
tagline: Peaceful country charm with tall pines, spacious lots, and dependable staff.
officeHours: Mon–Fri: 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM | Sat: By Appointment | Sun: Closed
description: Nestled among Inland Northwest ponderosa pine trees just east of Spokane, Pine Valley offers quiet, nature-embracing residential living. Extra-wide lots provide privacy, garden spaces, and a peaceful retreat with city conveniences only 10 minutes away.

pricing.utilitiesIncluded: Trash collection, deep-well water system maintenance, common grounds mowing
pricing.utilitiesSeparate: Electricity, sub-metered community septic system fee ($28/mo flat), satellite/internet

amenities: Pet Friendly (Large Dogs Allowed with Pre-Approval)
Mature Shade Pine Trees on Every Lot
On-Site Management Office & Resident Mail Station
Wide Paved Roads with Ample Turnarounds

rulesSnapshot.pets: Pet-friendly with pre-approval (up to 2 pets). Proof of rabies vaccination required.
rulesSnapshot.parking: 2 vehicle spaces per home site. Boat and utility trailer parking permitted in rear yard with manager sign-off.
rulesSnapshot.maintenance: Residents maintain yard borders; seasonal pine needle clearance services provided biannually by community crew.
rulesSnapshot.rvs: Short-term visiting family RV hookup available for up to 14 days.

nearbyServices.grocery: Yoke's Fresh Market (2.1 miles), Rosauers Supermarket (3.5 miles)
nearbyServices.schools: Central Valley High School (3.2 miles), Greenacres Middle (2.1 miles)
nearbyServices.healthcare: MultiCare Valley Hospital (4.5 miles), Providence Sacred Heart (12 miles)
nearbyServices.commute: I-90 (6 mins), Pines Rd / Hwy 27 (4 mins), Downtown Spokane (15 mins)
nearbyServices.recreation: Spokane Valley Mall (8 mins), Dishman Hills Conservation Area (10 mins)

faqs.q: Are single-wide and double-wide homes both permitted?
faqs.a: Yes! We have lots suited for standard 16x80 single-wides as well as 28x70 multi-section homes with skirting and front porches.

faqs.q: Is the community on city water or well water?
faqs.a: Pine Valley operates a state-inspected, regularly tested private deep-well water system that provides high-quality Washington fresh water.

faqs.q: Are there rental homes available right now?
faqs.a: We currently have 2 newly refurbished manufactured homes for rent. Contact management or view our listings tab for current floor plans.

name: Cedar Grove Community
tagline: Scenic, quiet South Sound valley living with spacious shaded lots.
officeHours: Mon–Fri: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM | Sat: 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM | Sun: Closed
description: Cedar Grove is a tranquil, beautifully maintained manufactured home community located along River Road with scenic views toward Mount Rainier. Designed for residents seeking peace, pride in homeownership, and friendly neighbors.

pricing.utilitiesIncluded: Curbside trash, common area landscape care, community garden water
pricing.utilitiesSeparate: City of Puyallup municipal water/sewer and electric sub-metered

amenities: Tranquil Setting with Native Cedars & Evergreen Trees
Community Garden Plots with Raised Beds
Resident Vehicle Maintenance Bay (Clean Air & Water)
On-Site Management with Direct Cell Hotline

rulesSnapshot.pets: Indoor cats and small dogs up to 30 lbs allowed (maximum 2 pets total). Pet registration on file required.
rulesSnapshot.parking: Designated concrete pads for 2 vehicles. Guest parking spots provided near clubhouse.
rulesSnapshot.maintenance: Properties must maintain clean skirting, weed-free garden beds, and approved storage sheds.
rulesSnapshot.rvs: No permanent RV living; clean RV parking lot for residents' personal travel trailers.

nearbyServices.schools: Puyallup High School (2.5 miles), Kalles Junior High (2.1 miles)
nearbyServices.healthcare: MultiCare Good Samaritan Hospital (3.4 miles), Sound Family Medicine (2.0 miles)
nearbyServices.commute: SR-167 (4 mins), SR-512 (6 mins), Tacoma (15 mins), Sounder Train Station (8 mins)
nearbyServices.recreation: Puyallup Riverwalk Trail (1 mile), Bradley Lake Park (3.5 miles)

faqs.a: Cedar Grove welcomes all ages while maintaining a quiet, mature residential atmosphere that is especially popular with active retirees and working professionals.

faqs.q: Can I install a carport or storage shed on my lot?
faqs.a: Yes! Manufactured carports and storage sheds up to 10x12 ft matching the home's color palette are permitted upon routine manager architectural review.

faqs.q: How do I secure an available lot for my home?
faqs.a: Complete our lot rental application, submit photos of your home, and place a refundable deposit to hold your preferred home site while permits and transport are arranged.

name: Willow Creek Village
tagline: Convenient SW Washington commuter location with new infrastructure and RV sites.
officeHours: Mon–Fri: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM | Sat: 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM | Sun: Closed
communityType: All-Ages Community with RV / Trailer Section
description: Located in thriving Clark County, Willow Creek Village features newly paved roadways, upgraded utility pedestals, and a dedicated extended-stay RV and trailer section in addition to permanent manufactured homes. Perfect for commuters and growing families with easy access to Portland.

pricing.utilitiesIncluded: Curbside trash, community lighting, street maintenance
pricing.utilitiesSeparate: City of Vancouver electric and water/wastewater sub-metered
pricing.leaseTerms: 12-month lease for home sites; flexible 3/6/12-month leases for RV sites

amenities: Dedicated Full-Hookup RV & Trailer Section (30/50 Amp)
On-Site Laundromat with Modern Card Readers

rulesSnapshot.pets: Pets welcome! Up to 2 pets per site. Pet waste stations placed throughout the community.
rulesSnapshot.parking: 2 designated parking stalls per manufactured home site; 1 vehicle + 1 RV per RV site.
rulesSnapshot.maintenance: Clean site standard maintained. No outdoor appliance storage or disabled vehicle repairs.
rulesSnapshot.rvs: RVs in travel section must be fully self-contained, manufactured 2012 or newer, and in clean working condition.

nearbyServices.schools: Fort Vancouver High School (2.2 miles), McLoughlin Middle (1.8 miles)
nearbyServices.healthcare: PeaceHealth Southwest Medical Center (2.8 miles), Vancouver Clinic (2.1 miles)
nearbyServices.commute: SR-500 (3 mins), I-205 (6 mins), I-5 (8 mins), Downtown Portland (20 mins)
nearbyServices.recreation: Vancouver Waterfront Park (12 mins), Burnt Bridge Creek Trail (5 mins)

faqs.q: Do you offer spaces for travel trailers and 5th wheels?
faqs.a: Yes! Our North Section offers 32 dedicated RV/trailer sites with complete 30/50 amp electric, city water, and direct sewer hookups on month-to-month or annual terms.

faqs.q: How close is the community to Clark College and downtown Vancouver?
faqs.a: We are approximately 8 to 10 minutes from both Clark College and the vibrant Vancouver waterfront, making this a popular and affordable option for commuters.

faqs.q: Is the swimming pool open year-round?
faqs.a: The community swimming pool is open seasonally from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day with daily maintenance and certified chemical balance testing.
